items.exampleEn: The old radio is still functional after fifty years.
items.exampleZh: 那台老收音機五十年後還能用。

items.exampleEn: The museum has fixed opening hours.
items.exampleZh: 那間博物館的開放時間是固定的。

items.exampleEn: The exact date of his birth is not known.
items.exampleZh: 他確切的出生日期沒有人知道。

items.exampleEn: The two teams had a fierce fight for first place.
items.exampleZh: 兩隊為了爭奪第一名打得非常激烈。

items.exampleEn: There is a striking difference between the two photos.
items.exampleZh: 這兩張照片之間有很明顯的差異。

items.exampleEn: Tall grass grows along the rim of the lake.
items.exampleZh: 湖的邊緣長滿了高高的草。

items.exampleEn: The two coaches talked privately before the game.
items.exampleZh: 兩位教練在比賽前私下談話。

items.exampleEn: Dense fog closed the airport for three hours.
items.exampleZh: 濃霧讓機場關閉了三個小時。

items.sentenceEn: The lion gave a fierce roar when the visitors came too close.
items.sentenceZh: 遊客靠得太近時，獅子兇猛地吼了一聲。

items.audioEn: The bus leaves at fixed times, every twenty minutes from seven a.m.
items.audioZh: 公車在固定時間發車，從早上七點起每二十分鐘一班。
options: Only once an hour in the morning

items.sentenceEn: Some of the paintings are privately owned and not shown to the public.
items.sentenceZh: 有些畫是私人收藏的，不對大眾展出。

items.sentenceEn: There is a coffee stain on the rim of my cup.
items.sentenceZh: 我的杯緣上有一塊咖啡漬。

items.stemEn: The forest is so ____ that very little sunlight reaches the ground.
items.stemZh: 那片森林茂密到幾乎沒有陽光能照到地面。

items.stemEn: Her father is ____ to everyone in the village as a kind man.
items.stemZh: 村裡每個人都知道她父親是個善良的人。

items.passageEn: Last month, I visited a furniture exhibition in Taipei. The most striking piece was a red chair made from old car parts. It looked strange, but it was fully functional, and visitors could sit on it. The designer, a young woman known for her use of recycled materials, sells her chairs at a fixed price of ten thousand dollars. Another room showed lamps with gold rims and tables made of dense, heavy wood, some of them carved by hand. Competition between designers is fierce, she told me privately, so she works seven days a week.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我去台北參觀了一場家具展。最醒目的作品是一張用舊汽車零件做成的紅色椅子。它看起來很怪，但完全可以使用，參觀者還能坐上去。設計師是一位以使用回收材料聞名的年輕女性，她的椅子以一萬元的固定價格出售。另一個展間展出有金色邊框的檯燈，以及用密實厚重的木頭做成的桌子，有些還是手工雕刻的。她私下告訴我，設計師之間競爭很激烈，所以她一週工作七天。

questions.questionZh: 展覽中最醒目的作品是什麼？
options: 用舊汽車零件做的紅色椅子

questions.questionZh: 設計師私下告訴作者什麼？

items.promptZh: 她穿了一件很搶眼的紅色洋裝去參加派對。
referenceEn: She wore a striking red dress to the party.
She went to the party in a striking red dress.
rubricZh: 「搶眼的」可寫，例如 striking 等
時態合理（例如 wore、went 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 functional 造一個句子，描述一樣你覺得很實用的東西。
referenceEn: My old backpack is not pretty, but it is very functional.
I prefer functional furniture with lots of storage space.
rubricZh: functional 可放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 functional furniture、is functional 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、prefer 等）
